text_steps: System Down: any user is unable to perform any normal System function due to a failure in a component other than the workstation
Unplanned downtime: time period when the System is unavailable
System Restoration: restore the System with inline synchronization after software or hardware failure
Normal/Operational state: implied state when the System is not down
Provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under standard and peak conditions
Perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds
Perform an advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds
Retrieve and display a case accessed within the previous 2 months within 5-8 seconds
Retrieve and display a case not accessed within the previous 2 months within 20 seconds
Support scalability for use in small or large police stations with varying numbers of cases

System prompts customer to fill out registration fields (first name, last name, billing address, shipping address, email, password)

System validates the customer's information

System creates a session cookie
System displays an account home page to Customer
